model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly Democratic: a D+19 seat, an incumbent with a massive financial advantage, and markets pricing her win probability near 97%. With no polling or ratings suggesting competition, the forecast stays at a Safe D margin near 25 points.
model.watch: Any sign of a well-funded challenger or unexpected incumbent controversy would be the first signal of movement, but none is currently visible.

overview:
Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez seeks reelection in a New York City district that leans Democratic by about 19 points. She enters the general election after securing her party's nomination with an enormous resource advantage, having raised more than $32 million and holding roughly $16 million on hand. Republican Diamant Hysenaj has raised under $350,000 and reports only about $31,000 in cash, with no outside spending on either side.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets put the Democratic side near 97 percent. The combination of district lean, incumbency, and the fundraising gap makes this a Safe Democratic seat, with the main uncertainty limited to turnout variation rather than a genuine contest.
